Write it down or keep it somewhere safe: it’s shown only this once. If you forget your password, this key opens your backups. Without the password and the recovery key nobody can recover your data, not even the app’s makers.

Your backups are now encrypted, in the app’s private folder in Google Drive. The old, unencrypted “Good Company backup.json” is still in your Drive, where anyone with access to your Drive can read it. Delete it? It goes to your Drive’s bin.
